text:
Platinum Price in 2000
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2000, the LBMA platinum price rose 25.1% between 2000-01-31 ($495) and 2000-12-28 ($619). The highest sampled price was $619 in December and the lowest was $482 in March. The mean of these observations was $554. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
